text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is the year-end Grand Prix. It's a seasonal tradition that even many who don't normally watch races tune in to see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Girls who epitomized that year, girls with immense popularity...
Many highly anticipated Umamusume entered the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among them, Buena Vista, making her debut—
had once again placed 1st in the popularity poll for "The 1st."
choice_data_list: You've broken the record for consecutive races as the top favorite again...
You've broken the record for consecutive races as the top favorite again, haven't you...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm grateful, but
I never expected it at the Arima Kinen of all places.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because... Journey-san and so many other
amazing Umamusume are running.
choice_data_list: Maybe it was influenced by the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the recent Japan Cup, Vodka became the first Japanese Tiara Umamusume to claim victory.
As one who carries on that momentum—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having made such a massive impact on this year's Triple Tiara circuit, perhaps great things are expected of her.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista is going to become just like Vodka!
No, maybe even greater...
She is truly a powerhouse Tiara Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The first Arima Kinen victory for a Classic-year Tiara Umamusume in ages!
I've seen the future, so there's no doubt about it!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!?
Can this person see into the future...!?"
choice_data_list: ...That's just a sign of how much they hope it happens!
...That's just a sign of how much they hope it happens!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
...Yeah.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to give back to them. Not just for today...
but with all my gratitude for their support up until now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
I'll go do my best!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: Don't you need to take a deep breath?
Don't you need to take a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen draws tremendous attention. In other words,
she will be exposed to more excitement than ever before.
It might affect her state of mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially since it's the Grand Prix...
the desire to run "for everyone's sake"
must be stronger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...Thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure it'll be okay. I can tell...
Everyone's expectations will be the wind at my back!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, if anything...
maybe you're the one who needs a deep breath, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Your brow is all furrowed.
...Here, let me give you a hand, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ready?
...*deep inhale*... *exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Did you relax a bit?
choice_data_list: ...Sorry, and I'm supposed to be your Trainer...
...Sorry, and I'm supposed to be your Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm glad. It shows just how much heart you're putting into this, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Then please watch over me...
as your usual wonderful self!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
it's Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"‘You'll be fine!’
‘I know you can do it...!’"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"No matter the opponent, no matter the track, you'll be fine!"
"We believe in you, Buena-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Go get 'eeeeeem!!
Do your best, Buena Vistaaa!!
choice_data_list: (The atmosphere feels completely different from before...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the Triple Tiara route, expectations were so high that winning was treated as a given.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet the gaze directed at her now... carries the burning hope that "she can do it," yearning for future change... and that fervor runs high.
choice_data_list: (But... it's okay. If it's Buena as she is now—)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: (I'm so grateful, really. Today's excitement... actually feels pretty good!)

text_block_list.name: Unicalize
text_block_list.text: —You seem to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
!
Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones who called out to Buena Vista were
Satsuki Sho winner Unicaliser,
and Kikuka Sho winner Sansha Sangyo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And At the Crest, who ran in the Japan Cup
the other day... is a rival I ran my Debut Race with."

text_block_list.name: Unicalize
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Being able to gather together with everyone like this again...
makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: At the Crest
text_block_list.text:
I mean it! I'm not gonna lose today, okay?
And I'm gonna make that Make Debut
even more legendary!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, absolutely! Let's make it legendary!

text_block_list.name: Sansha Sangyo
text_block_list.text: "Buena-san. I've been watching your successes... very closely~."

text_block_list.name: Sansha Sangyo
text_block_list.text:
I've managed to win the Kikuka Sho and make a name for myself too~.
...Let's both run our hearts out out there~.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I won't lose to any of you either!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How naive.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The cheers for you are as tremendous as ever... They echo all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly...
I'm so grateful!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...
Is that how you perceive these massive cheers?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"You are a curious person.
Gentle, and easily swayed like a young maiden."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And yet—she never wavers.
In fact, she has an extraordinarily solid core...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... it makes me want to know.
When your dazzling brilliance is shrouded—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of view awaits us there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Journey...-san...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. ...You see, Buena-san,
I have been looking forward to today very much.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please go easy on me.
I'm in your care.
...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
May I have a moment too?
There's something I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Why don't we take a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry if I'm mistaken!
Journey-san, it just felt like you were... a little agitated.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's a special race, after all. That's why...
I want everyone to run in tip-top shape.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So Journey-san won't have any regrets either.
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's right.
You really are... that kind of person.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
……I'll have to pass.
—Stay safe yourself out there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Let's both do our best!
